vyzhimka.tekst:
Here are the best places to start looking for construction-focused fractional CFOs in Tampa Bay:

### Directories and review sources

- **Sam’s List – Fractional CFOs for Construction in Tampa**  
  [samslist.com/fractional-cfos/industry/construction/city/tampa](https://samslist.com/fractional-cfos/industry/construction/city/tampa)  
  This is probably the most targeted directory. It lists construction-oriented CFOs, profiles, specialties, and client feedback. The search results show providers such as **STAXX Fractional CFO & Accounting, Ever Ledger, Pillar Wealth, Bison CFO, and Proview CFO**.

- **Sam’s List – Fractional CFOs in Tampa generally**  
  [samslist.com/fractional-cfo/tampa](https://samslist.com/fractional-cfo/tampa)  
  Broader than construction, but useful for comparing review counts and finding firms that may have relevant construction experience.

- **Clutch – Fractional CFO services**  
  [clutch.co/financial-services/fractional-cfo-services](https://clutch.co/financial-services/fractional-cfo-services)  
  Look for Tampa-based firms and filter by finance/accounting services, company size, and client reviews. Clutch is useful for more formal reviews, though not every listing is construction-specific.

### Tampa-area firms worth screening

- **Build CFO** – Specifically markets fractional CFO services to construction and real estate companies.  
  [buildcfo.co](https://buildcfo.co/)

- **K-38 Consulting** – Tampa CFO services page includes construction-focused testimonials and outsourced CFO support.  
  [k38consulting.com/tampa-fl-cfo-services](https://k38consulting.com/tampa-fl-cfo-services/)

- **Nperspective CFO & Strategic Services** – Serves Tampa and lists construction among its industries, with services including fractional CFO, forecasting, reporting, and profitability analysis.  
  [nperspective.com](https://nperspective.com/)

- **AMG Advisors Group / Mark Garcia** – Tampa-based fractional CFO and advisory services with construction experience, including job costing, project cash-flow planning, subcontractor controls, and construction-project oversight.

- **406 Consulting Group** – Offers controller and fractional CFO services across Florida, including Tampa, with construction and real estate listed among its target industries.  
  [406consultinggroup.com/locations/florida](https://406consultinggroup.com/locations/florida)

- **Keystone Consulting Team** – Tampa-based firm serving construction and trades businesses.  
  [keystoneconsultingteam.com](https://keystoneconsultingteam.com/)

- **FAFB Consulting Group** – Tampa fractional CFO services specifically mention construction and trades.  
  [fafbconsulting.com/tampa-fl-fractional-cfo-services](https://fafbconsulting.com/tampa-fl-fractional-cfo-services/)

- **The Gabb Group** – Based in the Riverview/Tampa area and offers fractional CFO services, cash-flow planning, budgeting, and financial oversight.  
  [thegabbgroup.com/fraction-cfo-services](http://www.thegabbgroup.com/fraction-cfo-services)

### What to verify before hiring

For a construction company, ask whether the CFO has hands-on experience with:

- **Percentage-of-completion accounting**
- **Job costing and WIP schedules**
- **Change orders and retainage**
- **Overhead allocation**
- **Subcontractor compliance and payment controls**
- **Cash-flow forecasting by project**
- **Surety bonding and bank reporting**
- **QuickBooks Enterprise, Sage 100 Contractor, Viewpoint, Procore, or similar systems**
- **Construction company tax planning and acquisition/exit preparation**

I would use Sam’s List to create a shortlist, then independently verify each candidate through Google reviews, LinkedIn, client references, and a conversation with a local construction CPA or surety/bank adviser. A provider describing itself as a fractional CFO may primarily offer bookkeeping, so it is worth asking for a sample monthly dashboard or construction-specific reporting package before engaging them.
